title: Cloud-Native Game Server Orchestrator
description: A one-click deployment pipeline automating provisioning of OCI compute, VCN networking, security lists, and firewall rules.
bullets: Built a one-click deployment pipeline using PowerShell and Terraform to automate provisioning of OCI compute, VCN networking, security lists, and firewall rules.
Wrote a Bash cloud-init template configuring iptables and a systemd-managed Flask REST API for remote start/stop/status management of the game server.
Automated SSH key generation via Terraform's tls_private_key provider and used file provisioners to upload game modifications to the server at deploy time.

title: Heart Anomaly Detection System
description: An early-exit neural architecture with learnable confidence thresholds, containerized and orchestrated for real-time medical predictions.
bullets: Designed a decreasing-width early-exit neural architecture in PyTorch with learnable confidence thresholds and a compound loss balancing accuracy, efficiency, and carbon cost.
Containerized with Docker, authored Kubernetes manifests (Deployments, HPA, liveness probes, PVC), and streamed real-time predictions via FastAPI and WebSockets.
Used a dual learning-rate optimizer strategy, training model weights and learnable exit thresholds at separate rates to prevent routing collapse during early training.

title: Co-Evolutionary Market Simulation
description: A bid-ask market simulation where a Double DQN agent quotes spreads against an evolving population over real OHLCV data.
bullets: Built a bid-ask market simulation where a Double DQN agent quotes spreads against an EGT population evolving via replicator dynamics over real OHLCV data.
Implemented a hybrid reward signal combining PnL, normalized returns, inventory risk penalties, and mean-reversion incentives to enforce market-neutral behavior.
Computed post-simulation performance analytics including annualized Sharpe ratio, max drawdown, and return distribution skew/kurtosis to evaluate strategy robustness.

title: Distributed Network Intrusion Detection System
description: A honeypot-based NIDS deploying traps on HTTP, FTP, SSH, and UDP ports with real-time remote monitoring.
bullets: Built a honeypot-based NIDS in Node.js, deploying traps on HTTP, FTP, SSH, and UDP ports with regex detection for SQLi, XSS, directory traversal, brute force, and RCE.
Streamed classified threat events to a centralized OCI-hosted Express dashboard for real-time remote monitoring from any browser.
Designed protocol-specific traps for HTTP, FTP, SSH, and UDP, each parsing different payloads (URLs, credentials, handshake banners, raw datagrams) to maximize detection coverage.
